## 11. Hollow Sprints

Exercise Objective: Develop proper stride length and stride frequency, as well as explosive power

## Procedure

1. Perform the following intervals consecutively without stopping (-22):
- A. Jog for 10 yards
- B. Sprint for 10 yards
- C. Jog for 10 yards
- D. Sprint for 10 yards
- E. Jog for 10 yards
2. This drill can also be performed using 20-yard increments (100 yards total for the drill) and 30-yard increments (150 yards total for the drill)
